animation.name: Neutral Front · Bubble-gum idle
animation.description: Hugo gets bored, blows grape gum, wipes the splat, then returns to neutral.

generationStrategy: 34 approved stabilized key drawings plus 34 exact adjacent-pair 50% bridge drawings; one timing tick each; exact frame-01 bookend

rootRegistration.method: common-canvas fallback; cream panels not detectable

source.interpolation: 50% between weight shift and toe-lift anticipation
50% between raised toe and both shoes grounded
50% bubble size between medium and large
right hand halfway from side to face on a clean arc
right hand halfway from raised position to gum contact
first visible peel with gum still mostly on the face
halfway arm extension and elastic gum length
gum just detached; right hand recoiling halfway inward
right wrist and elbow halfway lowering; exactly two arms
one-third transition: wrist flicks purple gum away
two-thirds transition: gum is gone and right arm is halfway down

registration.method: cream-chest-panel opacity-mask root; uniform transform only
